transcript.text: my washin mashine wont turn on at all no lights nothin

A completely dead washing machine with no lights usually points to a lack of mains power rather than an internal fault. Please first confirm the socket is working by plugging in another device, and check if the plug's fuse is intact. If the socket has power but the machine remains dead, we will need to look at the plug connection or the internal wiring.
the kettle works in the kitchen sockets so they have power. i cant get to the plug tho its behind the machine, its built in behind a cupboard door

Before you start, switch it off and unplug it. The plug may have worked its way loose behind the cupboard, or there could be a fault in the cable or rear inlet. Please pull the machine out just enough to access the back panel (you can turn it off first for safety). Check that the mains lead is firmly seated into the socket on the machine and inspect that area for any signs of burning, melting, or loose wires. Let me know what you see there.
i cant pull it out, its built in and im not allowed to take the cupboard off. i dont have any tools either. is there anything else i can check?
The problem is likely a loose connection at the inaccessible plug or a fault in the internal wiring/PCB. Please contact a qualified appliance engineer to inspect the mains supply path safely.
